name: Howden / KK&K and CKD industrial centrifugal compressors - single and multistage (SF, SFG, ST, SL, RS, RV, SFO/SFP/SFN)
description: Page states proven over 100 years and 4000 installations; standardized modular units; drivers electric motor or steam/gas turbine; controls via variable inlet guide vanes, variable diffuser guide vanes or speed control. Linked downloadable brochures are PDFs (not read).
